title: Black embroidered organza skirt, styled simply
seo_title: Black Embroidered Organza Midi Skirt — Styled
meta_description: A sheer organza midi skirt with tonal embroidered blooms, lined underneath, styled with one ivory tank. Watch how the hem falls before you decide.
intro: Black is easy. Black with texture is interesting. This organza midi is embroidered with tonal blooms that only show when the light catches them, so it reads plain from across a room and detailed up close.
alt: Black embroidered organza midi skirt on a hanger and styled on a form with an ivory sleeveless top

chapters.label: The two pieces on the rail

sections.heading: What you are looking at
paragraphs: A full midi skirt in sheer black organza, embroidered all over with blooms in the same black thread. The embroidery has a slight sheen, so the pattern appears and disappears as you move. Underneath is an opaque lining that stops above the organza hem, which gives the edge that floating line you can see in the video.
The waist is a smooth flat band with a little stretch. The volume starts below it, so the skirt is full without adding width where you do not want it.
bullets: Sheer organza over an opaque lining
Tonal black embroidery, no contrast thread

sections.heading: How we styled it
paragraphs: One ivory sleeveless knit, tucked. That is the whole outfit. A skirt with this much texture does better next to something plain, and the warm ivory keeps the black from feeling severe.
For evening, swap the knit for a black one and let the whole look go tonal. The embroidery is the only pattern you need.
bullets: Ivory or cream fitted top, tucked at the front
Pointed flats by day, a heeled sandal at night
Small gold jewellery — the sheen in the thread does the rest

sections.heading: Why we bought it
paragraphs: Most black skirts in this price range are flat crepe. This one has a reason to exist: the embroidery is dense, the organza is crisp rather than limp, and the lining is cut properly so the hem keeps its shape. It is the piece you keep for the occasions you cannot predict.

sections.heading: Fit and care
paragraphs: True to size through the waist with a little give. Organza creases when it is folded, so hang it rather than stacking it. Cold hand wash or gentle dry clean, hang to dry, and press only the lining with a cool iron under a cloth.

faqs.q: Is the black organza skirt lined?
faqs.a: Yes. There is an opaque lining through the body that ends above the organza hem, so the sheer edge floats while everything above it stays covered.
No. The stitching sits on the outer organza layer and the lining keeps it off your skin.

faqs.q: What top works with a full black skirt?
faqs.a: Something fitted and plain. An ivory or black sleeveless knit, tucked, keeps the shape balanced. Save prints for a different day.

faqs.q: Can I wear it to a wedding?
faqs.a: It works well as a guest, paired with a soft-coloured top so the look is not head-to-toe black. Check the invitation for the dress code first.
